label: common_0220_rival_00
text: All right, here I am! We finally made it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_01
text: This is Mesagoza! The biggest city in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_02
text: It’s been a big trade hub since a long time ago.\c\nLots of folks come here to learn about advances\nin technology and all kinds of other stuff.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_03
text: There’s a hair salon where you can change your\nlook, plus places with tasty food and fixings...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]What do you want to see first,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_05a
text: Oh, you’re a fashionista, are you?\c\nOr maybe you just want a practical ’do that won’t\nget in your eyes when you’re battling![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_05b
text: Hah! I didn’t have you pegged for a big eater!\c\nBut that’s smart. You can’t battle well with a\ngrowling tummy, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_07
text: I wanna be sure you’ll be able to Terastallize\nyour Pokémon too, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_08
text: There’s a few things that gotta get done for that\nto happen, but I’ll take care of ’em![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_09
text: Meanwhile, you just have fun looking around the\ncity a bit![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_12
text: There’s so much to do—grab a bite, buy some\naccessories to spice up your uniform...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_13
text: If you want my personal recommendation, you’ve\ngotta see Delibird Presents! They sell handy\r\nitems for Pokémon to hold.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_10
text:
Once you’ve seen your fill, we can meet up again
in front of the school!\c
Just...be ready. The stairs up to school are
no joke.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0220_rival_11
text: Later, then! Get pumped for some Terastallizing![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
